phases.title: Spike: particle system + intro feel
phases.summary: Throwaway prototype validating the particle field, particle-ring loader, and one intro-assembly animation before committing to a real spec. Same precedent as 2a's pre-implementation Plotly spike.

steps.title: Ambient particle-field prototype
steps.detail: Build a scratch canvas particle-field prototype: sparse accent-green (#9fe870) dots on #0d0f0c, slow drift, no layout-affecting properties (transform/opacity only). Validates ideas #6-9 (ambient generative background). Not a React component yet -- vanilla canvas/JS is fine, this is throwaway.

steps.title: Particle-ring loader prototype
steps.detail: Build a particle-ring loader: dots assemble into a ring/torus shape and loop, matching the shape observed in inspo2's dot-ring frame. Validates idea #20 (replaces the plain 'Loading...' text). Reuses 0.1's particle primitives.

steps.title: Intro-sequence prototype
steps.detail: Build one intro sequence: the tradefabe wordmark assembles from scattered drifting particles, a single bold headline reveals word-by-word, then settles/fades into a mock row-list backdrop. Validates ideas #1-2 and #4 (session-gated, overlaps the first fetch).

steps.title: Live review with Dave
steps.detail: Open the three prototypes as a lavish artifact for a live reaction: does this feel good or distracting? Capture verdict and any parameter adjustments (particle count, speed, colors, timing, duration) before Phase 1's real spec is written.

steps.title: Discard the spike
steps.detail: Never commit the spike code. Carry forward only the specific parameters that worked (from 0.4) into Phase 1's real implementation. Delete or leave untracked under .lavish/ (already gitignored).

validated_params.note: Dave's approved slider values from the live review, 2026-08-08. These are the numbers Phase 1's real ParticleField / ring loader / Intro components should start from.
techniques_to_carry_forward: ambient field: per-particle wander force + drag (not constant-velocity linear drift), depth-based parallax, spatial-grid constellation network (connectDots), additive glow via globalCompositeOperation='lighter' + radial-gradient dots
ring loader: damped spring toward rotating ring target (semi-implicit Euler) instead of snapping to trig position, neighboring dots connected into a glowing outline

intro: easeOutBack (slight overshoot-and-settle) instead of easeOutCubic; constellation lines between in-flight particles while assembleT < 1; must sample getImageData using the canvas's actual INTEGER pixel dims, not float CSS w/h (real bug hit during the spike)

phases.title: Shell & foundation
phases.summary: App-shell-level visual language: real particle background replacing the flat grain overlay, deeper haptic sound design, the intro sequence, brand glyph, leaned-in accent color. Everything downstream (Phase 2/3/4) inherits this for free once it ships.

steps.title: ParticleField component + tests
steps.detail: Write failing Vitest tests for the particle math (generation, drift step function) as pure functions, then implement a ParticleField component using the parameters validated in Phase 0. Mount it in App.tsx replacing .grain-overlay. Must freeze to a static frame under prefers-reduced-motion (not just slow down) and stay compositor-only (transform/opacity).

steps.title: Deeper sound design
steps.detail: Extend sound.ts: layer a noise-shaped texture under playSelect/playRangeChange (idea #11), give playDataLanded a lower 'thunk' character (idea #12). Write tests mirroring sound.test.ts's existing AudioContext-mocking style. Idea #13 (per-family pitch nudge) and #14 (opt-in ambient drone, likely skip) are optional stretch within this step.

steps.title: Intro/reveal sequence
steps.detail: Build Intro.tsx using Phase 0's validated parameters, mounted once per session (sessionStorage-gated) in App.tsx. Must overlap the first GET /api/books/summary fetch, not add latency on top of it (idea #4). Ends with a quiet sound sting on settle (idea #5).

steps.title: Brand glyph + sound-toggle pulse
steps.detail: Add the crossed-circle glyph motif (idea #41) to Nav.tsx and reuse it as the particle-ring loader's shape (ties to Phase 3's loading state). Add a subtle pulse on the Sound toggle when enabled and about to play (idea #43).

steps.title: Accent color + surface texture
steps.detail: Lean into the existing accent green (#9fe870) with a secondary tint token in tailwind.config.js (idea #37). Add a subtle organic texture to bg-surface via a cheap repeating SVG pattern (idea #38), not a flat fill.

steps.title: Accessibility + performance audit
steps.detail: Run fixing-motion-performance and fixing-accessibility skills against everything in this phase before merge. Confirm reduced-motion and audio-off states are equivalent experiences, not degraded ones (gates from ideas #46-48).

steps.title: Suites + PR
steps.detail: npm test, npm run build, pytest tests/ -n0 all green. Branch + PR per CLAUDE.md's git workflow, never push to main.

phases.title: Row list polish
phases.summary: Pure RowList.tsx work, zero shared code with DetailPanel or 2b. Sequenced after Phase 1 to inherit the new sound/spring feel, not because of a hard dependency -- could run in parallel with Phase 3 if ever resourced separately.

steps.title: Failing tests for the new interactions
steps.detail: Extend RowList.test.tsx with failing tests for: FLIP reorder on sort change, hover-lift, family-underline draw-in, up-for-review badge pulse, skeleton loading rows, sparkline end-dot, born-book burst.

steps.title: Family-header underline + hover lift
steps.detail: Idea #28: thin per-family accent underline draws in on first render. Idea #32: row hover gains translateY(-1px) + soft shadow instead of only a background tint.

steps.title: Up-for-review badge pulse
steps.detail: Idea #29: badge count pulses once when it changes between visits. Needs a previous-count comparison (e.g. localStorage) so it only pulses on an actual change, not every render.

steps.title: FLIP reorder on sort switch
steps.detail: Idea #30: sort-mode switch animates row reordering (FLIP-style position transition via Framer Motion layout animations) instead of an instant re-render.

steps.title: carry_btc_eth featured treatment
steps.detail: Idea #31: the one strategy that's cleared doctrine gets a subtly distinct row treatment, echoing Wise's differently-styled chip inside a repeating row. Keep it subtle -- not a second visual language, one accent difference.

steps.title: Skeleton rows + empty-state polish
steps.detail: Idea #21: ghost-row skeleton placeholders while loading, using bg-surface, instead of a blank 'Loading...' flash. Idea #22: lighter-weight treatment for a partially-populated 'Up for review' state (today's fully-empty state is already correctly hidden -- leave that as is).

steps.title: Sparkline end-dot + born-book burst
steps.detail: Idea #42: small colored dot as the literal end-marker on each sparkline. Idea #44: brief monochrome-accent burst the first time a brand-new paper book appears in the row list, tied to a real event (a book not seen before, tracked via localStorage), not decoration for its own sake.

steps.title: Suites + PR
steps.detail: npm test, npm run build green. Branch + PR.

phases.title: Detail panel visual-language upgrade
phases.summary: The actual merge point Dave asked for: every idea that upgrades content 2a already shipped in DetailPanel.tsx, done BEFORE sub-project 2b adds a second section to that same component. 2b then ships once, natively in this finished style.

steps.title: Failing tests for the new treatments
steps.detail: Extend DetailPanel.test.tsx with failing tests for: stat-tile rendering with the new style, verdict-stamp animation trigger (once per session per book), retired-frozen treatment, freshness ticker, divergence-status pulse, blurb word-reveal.

steps.title: Stat-tile depth treatment
steps.detail: Idea #33: the 6 existing stat tiles (Sharpe/Sortino/Calmar/MaxDD/CAGR/Vol) get individual subtle depth/border-glow instead of flat text in a row. THIS is what 2b's new 'Capital deployed' stat row (Phase 4) will reuse verbatim -- get the component/class reusable, not DetailPanel-specific inline styles.

steps.title: Oversized-number + typography motion
steps.detail: Idea #17: one number per view (today's equity) gets Wise-style oversized treatment vs. the other 5 stats. Idea #16: blurb reveals word-by-word on selection using the shared SPRING config. Idea #18: section headers get a subtle letter-spacing/opacity entrance.

steps.title: Verdict stamp + retired-frozen treatment
steps.detail: Idea #35: verdict badge (DEAD/ALIVE) gets a one-time 'stamp' animation on first render per session -- quick scale-in + slight rotation. Idea #36: retired-book panels get a 'frozen' desaturation/texture treatment, reinforcing that a retired ledger's record is deliberately frozen.

steps.title: Range-control feel + freshness/divergence indicators
steps.detail: Idea #25: RangeControl buttons get a tactile press (slight depress + spring release). Idea #26: a live 'as of Xs ago' mono-digit freshness indicator near the equity number. Idea #27: divergence-status badge pulses with a subtle glow when 'diverging'.

steps.title: Loading state + route transition
steps.detail: Idea #20: replace 'Loading...' with Phase 1's particle-ring loader. Idea #23: crossfade detail-panel content on /books/:name selection change instead of a hard swap.

steps.title: Chart tooltip restyle
steps.detail: Idea #45: restyle the Plotly tooltip/hover crosshair with the mono font + accent color in plotlyDarkTheme.ts, which already exists as the place to add it.

steps.title: Suites + PR
steps.detail: npm test, npm run build, pytest tests/ -n0 (no backend changes expected, run for safety) all green. Branch + PR.

phases.title: Sub-project 2b: positions / trade log / risk panel
files: src/tradefabe/api/main.py (verify only -- data already exposed via compute_positions)
phases.summary: Full parity with today's Streamlit render_strategy_panel, Option A layout (continuous scroll below the backtest-history expander -- Dave's explicit pick). Built on Phase 3's finished visual language so nothing here gets restyled later.

steps.title: Verify backend coverage
steps.detail: Confirm GET /api/books/{name}/detail already returns positions_df/deployment/trades_df/carry_risk data via the existing compute_positions flag (dashboard.py book_panel_data()). Add any missing API test coverage in tests/test_api_book_detail.py. Expect NO new backend endpoints -- 2a's spec deliberately designed the response shape to be additive here.

steps.title: Failing frontend tests
steps.detail: Write failing tests for the new positions table, trade log, and risk-monitor/risk-register rendering, covering both equity-book and carry-book kinds.

steps.title: Capital deployed stat row
steps.detail: Cash / gross / net / total-equity stat row for equity books, using Phase 3.2's stat-tile component directly -- not a new styled block.

steps.title: Positions table with weight-bar
steps.detail: Idea #34: current-positions table (ticker/units/last/value/weight) with a thin colored left-edge bar sized to |weight| built in from the start -- this is the same piece of work as building the table, not a follow-up.

steps.title: Trade log table
steps.detail: Fill log (when/ticker/side/delta-units/fill/notional/position-after), matching app.py's render_trade_log semantics (ACCRUAL_ONLY_BOOKS caption, 500-row cap, position-view side naming).

steps.title: Risk-monitor panel (carry book)
steps.detail: Funding-flip alerts per coin, 7d funding, leverage/liq-distance table pivoted by posture (10/25/50/100%), high-risk alert banner -- matching app.py's render_carry_risk_panel.

steps.title: Risk-register panel (carry book)
steps.detail: Expandable entries (severity badge, measured/cited tag, likelihood, impact, detail, source) -- matching app.py's render_risk_register.

steps.title: Wire Option A layout
steps.detail: Append all of the above below the existing backtest-history expander in DetailPanel, continuous scroll -- Dave's confirmed layout choice over the expander-based alternative.

steps.title: Manual full-stack smoke test + PR
steps.detail: Same rigor as sub-project 2a's Task 9: both dev servers, walk positions/trades/risk-panel for at least one equity book and the carry book, confirm dark-theme charts, confirm no regression in 2a's existing golden path. pytest + npm test green. Branch + PR, file the 2b issue if not already filed.

phases.title: Cross-cutting polish
phases.summary: The one idea that touches both RowList (Phase 2) and DetailPanel (Phase 3/4) -- needs both stable first. Delight-tier, not load-bearing.

steps.title: Sparkline-to-chart morph
steps.detail: Idea #24: clicking a row's tiny sparkline visually grows into the big Plotly chart (shared-element transition) rather than an unrelated redraw. Highest integration risk of any idea in the backlog -- prototype as a spike first if it fights Framer Motion's layout animation model.

steps.title: Suites + PR
steps.detail: npm test, npm run build green. Branch + PR.

not_scheduled.reason: Opt-in ambient drone/pad -- flagged in the original backlog as 'likely a no'. Revisit only if Dave asks for it explicitly.
